# Generative research

## Directives

From [Digital product development](digital-product-development.md):

- Name the user and the task of each feature before you design or build the feature. ^name-user-and-task

## Definition

Research that finds the needs, the pain points, and the contexts of the people that a product serves, before the team designs a solution. Nielsen Norman Group calls these methods generative because they help generate ideas and answers about which way to go.
